column1: # LOCK-TIMER-0001: every class at the lowest and highest level it can have, made by the server, naked, in the arena, set to 1 HP, MP and CP at 0 ms, standing still until 30000 ms, then sitting until 60000 ms.
# Each regeneration tick is <ms>:+<hp>/+<mp>/+<cp>, the gain of that tick to six decimals; a run of equal ticks at a fixed interval is <first>..<last>/<interval>:+<hp>/+<mp>/+<cp>.
